title: Introduce windowed SLO dampener and evacuation sentinel to reduce oscillatory failovers
author: Leah Morgan
description:
Motivation: During a recent multi-region incident we observed oscillatory regional failovers and repeated tenant quarantines caused by aggressive immediate SLO enforcements when transient latency spikes or KV pressure briefly crossed thresholds. This PR introduces two complementary runtime controls: a windowed SLO dampener (temporal smoothing of violation signals) and an evacuation sentinel (graceful, rate-limited node/tenant evacuation coordinator) to reduce flip-flopping and noisy circuit state changes.

What this changes (summary):
- Add a windowed SLO dampener that computes an exponentially-weighted moving percentile of latency/error signals per-tenant and per-region and requires sustained breach over a configurable window before triggering enforcement actions.
- Implement an evacuation sentinel that converts immediate hard-evacuate actions into a staged, tokenized evacuation process with a rate limiter and sticky-lease reconciliation to preserve KV locality where possible.
- Introduce a probation window for recently-evacuated tenants: short-lived soft-deprioritization to avoid immediate re-evacuation during recovery spikes.
- Instrumentation: new metrics (slo_dampener.windowed_p95, evacuation_sentinel.tokens_in_use, tenant_probation.state) and tracing spans to make decision boundaries auditable.
- Backwards-compatible config flags () and rollout knob via runtime-config to allow turning on dampener/evac-sentinel per-region.

Commits (high level):
- 1f8c2b2: core: add slo_dampener module with EWMA percentile state machine
- 2a9d5e1: controlplane: expose dampener config and rollout API to runtime-config service
- 4c3e7f9: runtime: evacuation_sentinel coordinator + tokenized evacuation protocol
- 7b1a9f0: kv: sticky-lease reconciliation and pause-on-preserve mode
- 9d0b4c4: telemetry: add metrics and tracing; dashboarding updates; alerts tuned
- b5f6a2d: tests: unit + integration harness for windowed breach scenarios and evacuation pacing

Files touched (high level):
- runtime/slo/dampener.rs (new)
- runtime/evac/sentinel.rs (new)
- controlplane/runtime_config/api.go (expose flags)
- kv/sticky_lease_manager.go (integration hooks)
- telemetry/metrics_registry.yml (metrics added)
- integration-tests/evacuation_playbooks/ (new scenarios)

Testing and validation:
- Unit tests for dampener state transitions (stable) and sentinel token accounting (edge cases).
- Integration canary in us-west-2 for low-traffic tenants for 72hrs verifying: reduced double-evacuations, stable KV hit-rate during recovery, and no SLO regression for top 99% of tenants.
- Load tests with synthetic latency spikes show >60% reduction in region flip-flop events in the simulated environment.

Operational notes / rollout plan:
- Feature gated behind runtime-config flag: rollout to 10% of regional traffic for 48h, then 50%, then global after metrics verified.
- New dashboards created under "SLO Dampener / Evac Sentinel" with target thresholds to watch: dampener_suppressed_triggers, evacuation_token_throttle_rate, tenant_probation_count.
- Rollback: flip runtime-config to off; sentinel will drain tokens and finish in-flight reconciliations within a bounded interval (configurable), no hard state lost.

Checklist: 
- [x] Unit tests
- [x] Integration scenarios
- [x] Telemetry wired
- [x] Docs: runtime-config flags and operator guide
- [x] Security review: no new privileged surfaces

Related: ENG-1892 (reduce regional failover oscillation), ENG-2045 (tenant-quarantine noise reduction).
review_comments:
Diego: Requested clearer invariants for when dampener marks a sustained breach — clarified threshold as configurable EWMA window and added unit tests.
Priya: Asked for eviction rate safety caps; added tokenized limiter and a hard ceiling tied to region capacity.
Noah: Ran integration canary and reported a KV-preserve regression in one corner case; fixed sticky-lease race by adding a short jitter and idempotency token.
Author replies: addressed all comments; re-ran canary and posted results in the PR thread.
release_notes: Introduce a windowed SLO dampener to prevent reactive oscillations and an evacuation sentinel that stages node/tenant evacuations to avoid noisy failovers. Feature is rollout-gated and can be disabled via runtime-config.
post_merge_actions: Monitor new slo_dampener.* and evacuation_sentinel.* metrics for 72h; promote to additional regions if no regressions. Run a retrospective after full rollout to verify reduction in double-evacuations.
notes_for_oncall: If an unexpected tenant SLA regression is observed, disable the dampener flag to fall back to immediate SLO enforcement. If evacuation tokens saturate unexpectedly, scale sentinel token bucket and investigate rapid node churn.
